feeds.title: Through Heather's Looking Glass
feeds.description: I am Heather Montgomery, a 36-year-old southern girl living in Mississippi with my husband and 6-year-old daughter. Two things, in particular, I enjoy teaching about would be Disney/travel, and self-improvement related topics.

feeds.title: Seeded At The Table
feeds.description: We're the Gladd family! We love donuts, Disney, LEGO and Jesus. Ben shares DIY wood-working projects and Nikki shares delicious recipes. You'll also find a sprinkling of travel adventures and other family fun ideas!

feeds.title: Sassy Southern Blonde
feeds.description: I started Sassy Southern Blonde two years ago as a creative outlet to share my southern style. This little hobby has quickly turned into me pursuing my ultimate dream of being a full-time fashion blogger! If you like bright colors and affordable fashion, my blog is for YOU! I enjoy sharing high-quality pieces that won't break the bank! I also love finding the best accessories to splurge on.

feeds.title: Rose Bakes
feeds.description: Cake Decorating, Baking, Tutorials, Recipes, Cake Photos & Inspiration. Rose is a Homeschool Teacher, a baker and a mom of 6 kids.

feeds.title: MississippiMom.com
feeds.description: MississippiMom.com, a site devoted to encouraging moms in the Magnolia State, features recipes, family events and attractions around the state, and much more!

feeds.title: Read. Write. Mom!
feeds.description: A Blogging Mom with an eBay Side Hustle. Through this blog, Mandy Zuniga offers free printables, recipes, and personal blog posts about her family.

feeds.title: Kassy On Design
feeds.description: I'm Kassy: 29 years old, mom of two, and wife to the Professor. I started this website in 2015 as a fashion blog and it has grown and transformed into my passion project and a place that I hope is a wealth of information and a source of joy! I share what I enjoy and what makes me smile. That often includes fashion, home interiors, family life, and DIY.

feeds.title: The Dinner Darling
feeds.description: I'm Lindsey, a busy mom of two on a budget. I started The Weekly Dish recipe subscription service to help busy people save time and money while creating delicious meals for their families.

feeds.title: Tristan Duplichain Photography Blog
feeds.description: Find posts on photography, fashion, business, travel and more. Tristan Duplichain is a mom, photographer, educator, and professional cat lady.

feeds.title: Deep South Dish
feeds.description: I'm Mary, a writer and recipe developer. Pull up a chair & join me while I cook up good ole South Southern recipes from my kitchen in the Deep South USA.
